Literal.Value:
'Recommended actions (from action codes)

• F-K2.1 — Cost Take-Out Orchestration
  Owner: finance_director
  Trigger: cost.unit.amount > 0.05%
  Impact: High, CostAvoidance
  Expected: 2.0–6.0 %
  Confidence: High
  · DETECT sustained unit cost deterioration for this plant/product
  · IDENTIFY the dominant cost driver (Material, Labor, OpEx) for this plant/product
  · ACTIVATE the corresponding execution Action Code for this plant/product
  ⚠ Trigger only if deviation is structural, not volume-mix driven
  ⚠ Do not trigger if margin erosion is price-driven (handled in COM-002)

• F-K2.2 — Material Cost Discipline
  Owner: head_of_procurement
  Trigger: cost.material.pct > 0.05%
  Impact: Medium, CostAvoidance
  Expected: 1.0–4.0 %
  Confidence: Medium
  · Identify plants/products with rising material cost share
  · Analyze scrap, yield, and spec adherence
  · Implement corrective sourcing or usage actions
  ⚠ Trigger only if yield remains within guardrails
  ⚠ Do not trigger if unit cost increase is labor-driven

• F-K2.3 — Labor Productivity Recovery
  Owner: plant_manager
  Trigger: ops.labor.productivity.pct < -6.0pp
  Impact: Medium, CostAvoidance
  Expected: 3.0–8.0 pp
  Confidence: Medium
  · Identify lines and shifts with productivity decline
  · Analyze staffing, shift balance, and idle time
  · Implement corrective scheduling and supervision actions
  ⚠ Trigger only if defect rate remains within guardrails
  ⚠ Do not trigger if productivity drop is driven by approved training or ramp-up

• F-K2.4 — OpEx Spend Control
  Owner: head_of_controlling
  Trigger: cost.opex.vs_plan.pct > 5.0pp
  Impact: Medium, CostAvoidance
  Expected: 2.0–6.0 pp
  Confidence: High
  · IDENTIFY entities or plants exceeding OpEx plan for this scope
  · CLASSIFY spend by discretionary vs committed for this scope
  · FREEZE, DEFER, or RE-APPROVE expenses for this scope
  ⚠ Trigger only if service levels remain within agreed thresholds
  ⚠ Do not trigger for costs already approved by executive committee'
